name: smwmusic-goof-troop-lose-my-way
title: Goof Troop - Lose My Way
description:
The catchy and eerie song played during Goof Troop's 4th level, which could fit into shady places such as castles or forests.

Update [2019/12/17]: Made it much more accurate to the original, with samples ripped from Goof Troop and an almost fully-redone mixing.
